items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: my star pupil, Mike Slattery, I used to give him hell about B flat

ctx.x: Well, relevant to this whole situation, you said there were some things you wanted to talk about in general about what a musician has to do after he learns to play his instrument.

Right. In this form of music, which is an ad lib form of music -- I won't say that it's jazz because that would be confining it to one line. I think a little more flexible than that. But the difference between being a symphony player and being a person to play ad lib was that the symphony player was disciplined bar by bar to make this B flat, and it was an impersonal B flat. I'm just using B flat as a note, because my star pupil, Mike Slattery, I used to give him hell about B flat, so he calls himself B flat Mike.
